sentences.text:
Applicant :- Vishnu Gupta
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Mohit Sharma,Mukul Kumar Sharma
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Mohit Sharma, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Ambrish Singh, learned Addl.
Government Advocate, and perused the record.

2. By means of the instant application the applicant Vishnu Gupta seeks bail in Case Crime No. 563 of 2020, under sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 406, 506, 120-B I.P.C.,P.S. Kotwali Nagar, District Faizabad/Ayodhya.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of a first information report (F.I.R.) lodged on 22.08.2020 against 19 named persons, including the applicant and one unknown person, alleging that the informant had invested Rs. 53,50,000/- in Eye Vision India Credit Cooperative Society Limited under an allurement of lucrative return.

entities.text: Eye Vision India Credit Cooperative Society Limited
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: After maturity, the invested amount was not paid to the informant.
4. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.
It has also been stated in the Vishnu Gupta vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

entities.text: Vishnu Gupta vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154789852/
1 affidavit that the applicant does not hold any position in the aforesaid Company and he has been implicated in the present case merely because his brother Ajeet Gupta is Director in the said Company.

5. The learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant is involved in 50 cases of similar nature, all arising out of transactions of the aforesaid Company and the he has been granted bail in 32 of those cases.
It has also been stated that the co-accused Ram Gopal Gupta, who is the brother of the applicant has been grated bail by means of an order dated 24.02.2023 passed by this Court.

6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping and view the fact that the applicant is not a Director of the company in which the informant had made Investments;
that the applicant was brother of a Director of the Company; that the applicant has been granted bail in 32 other cases of similar nature; that the applicant's another brother has already been granted bail and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the applicant is also entitled to be enlarged on bail in the present case also.
7. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.

(Subhash Vidyarthi,J.) Order Date :- 21.7.2023 Preeti.
